title: Operations shaped like Amplify Gen2
description:
As an app that runs against AWS Amplify or local files, I want local operations that behave exactly like Amplify's `client.models.X` (`get`, `list`, list by index, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `{data, errors, nextToken}`).

```gherkin
Feature: Amplify-shaped operations
  Background:
    Given an engine opened on the contract fixture "blog" as user "u1"

  Scenario: Create fills in id, timestamps and owner
    When I call create on "Post" with {"title": "Hi"}
    Then data has a generated "id", "createdAt" and "updatedAt", and "owner" is "u1"

  Scenario: Creating an existing id fails conditionally
    Given a "Post" with id "p1"
    When I call create on "Post" with {"id": "p1", "title": "Again"}
    Then data is null and errors[0].errorType is "DynamoDB:ConditionalCheckFailedException"

  Scenario: The limit applies before the filter, as in DynamoDB
    Given "Post" records "p0" to "p9" where "p0", "p3", "p6", "p9" have "draft" true
    When I list "Post" with filter {"draft": {"eq": true}} and limit 5
    Then the first page holds "p0", "p3" and nextToken is not null
    And collecting every page returns "p0", "p3", "p6", "p9"
```
